findings.text: _sha256_path is a verbatim reimplementation of the chunked file digest owned by reckon/project_state.py:361, in a file that already imports read_resource, resource_path and write_resource from that module; it should import the owner rather than fork it.
staging_root and REPORTS_PATH_KEYS add validation for a retention pass this node does not implement, so the schema advertises a store nothing here writes.
the done_when requires the real crew home and docs state untouched, but the autouse fixture asserts only the reports and runs subtrees of the crew home and never the real docs state.

the assertion compares figure_record["source"] with data_record["figure"], two values the code produced, so a figure field set from a path unrelated to the fixture would still satisfy it; store["figure"] is the independent source.
the refusal for a persist root inside the crew home is exercised by no test, so dropping that guard would leave the suite green.
the persisted_items registration is a production module the node's declared write paths did not include; the worker disclosed it and it needs coordinator ratification.
